thread:
Aisha: Heads-up — Cerebrix wants to run a 4-week POC next week. They have a custom model 'cerebrix-med-bert-7b' (originally FP16), want a 4-bit quant variant, KMS for PHI, and an SLA for 95th pct latency < 250ms for short queries (~128 tokens). Can SE/ML confirm compatibility and an estimated cost delta vs our standard med-7b?
Devin: @Aisha got it. Quick Qs: are they ok with lower context for now (512->256) if it helps latency? Also what throughput target?
Aisha: They expect ~30 qps bursty, avg 6 qps steady. Context can be reduced to 256 if we call that out in the SOW. They insist on KMS + audit logs.
Tara: Variant notes — 7B -> 4-bit (QLoRA-style) usually works but tokenization can differ if tokenizer was custom-trained. Need a tokenizer sample. Also KV-cache behavior: 4-bit kernels on Ampere+ are fine but we should avoid continuous batching > 64 tokens for latency SLO.
Chris: Infra caveat — to hit 95th <250ms at 30 qps bursts, plan is: dedicated pool (reserved), p3dn/p4d spots won't reliably meet latency. Recommend a small Dedicated fleet with 2x A100-80GB pooled + autoscale to 4 during sustained peaks, can set burst queue to warm cold starts.
Sasha: Security checklist — HIPAA questions: KMS integration OK; we need their BAAs signed and confirm no PHI persists in debug logs. Also require network ingress rules for Private deployment (VPC peering) or hosted with dedicated tenancy. I'll need the draft security questionnaire returned by EOD Thu.
Ben: Pricing/Commercial — for Dedicated with 2x baseline A100s + autoscale and KMS, rough monthly price = base reserved capacity + per-token runtime premium. Estimate: $55k/mo committed for the fleet, plus usage. I can produce a tighter quote once SE confirms batching/kv cache config and expected token volumes.
Aisha: @Tara can you validate tokenizer sample? I'll push them to share a small corpus. @Chris can you sketch the autoscale policy we should propose?
Tara: Sending tokenizer checklist: please ask Cerebrix to send (1) tokenizer.json, (2) 50 example inputs, (3) one long doc ~8k chars to test truncation/pathological cases. If tokenizer mismatches we may fallback to our med-7b tokenizers which can change token counts and cost.
Chris: Autoscale sketch: target_util=0.6, min_nodes=2, max_nodes=4, warm_pool=1, cooldown=60s. Batching policy: prefer latency-first with max_batch_tokens=4096 and max_batch_wait_ms=8ms. I'll attach a sample config snippet they can sign off on.
Aisha: Nice. @Sasha any blockers with KMS + audit logs in hosted mode (not private)?
Sasha: Hosted + KMS is allowed if customer uses their own KMS key via our KMS proxy and we enable strict key usage logs. Need legal to confirm BAAs; also confirm they want logs retained 90/180/365 days. Retention impacts cost.
Devin: Ops/SE checklist to validate before go: 1) tokenizer pass (Tara) 2) model weights converted & sanity-run (Tara/Devin) 3) perf sweep (Devin/Chris) 4) security sign-off (Sasha) 5) pricing SOW (Ben). I can run a quick perf sweep script:
```
# perf sweep (dev)
python perf_sweep.py --model cerebrix-med-bert-7b-4bit --ctx 256 --batch 1 --steps 200
```
Devin: If perf numbers look good we'll provide a POC SLA matrix (latency/throughput/cost) and a recommended rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48hrs with auto-fallback to med-7b-base.
Aisha: Customer question — can we support private deployment in their AWS account? They prefer control over VPC.
Chris: Yes, Private deployment in customer VPC is supported but requires an infra-onboarding window (2-3 weeks) and an on-call handover. That pushes POC start by ~2 weeks. Hosted Dedicated can start sooner.
Sasha: Also flag: if they want BYOK KMS in their VPC we need key policy checked and trust established.
Ben: I'll draft two price options: Hosted Dedicated quick-start (30 day trial pricing) and Private (setup fee + monthly).
Aisha: Next steps I'm sending to Cerebrix: token/sample checklist, draft autoscale config, two pricing options, and a security questionnaire. Will schedule a technical sync Wed.
deploy-bot: deployment-checklist: create ticket INF-4821 (POC: cerebrix), assign Tara (ml-eng) + Chris (infra) + Devin (solutions), due 2026-04-02.
Tara: I'll start weight conversion and tokenization validation once sample arrives. Expect initial perf numbers within 48h of receiving files.
Devin: I'll prepare the perf-sweep runners and a short eval harness for hallucination/regression checks to include in the POC acceptance criteria.
Aisha: Thanks team — I'll update Cerebrix after Wed tech sync. :thumbsup:
Sasha: One more: ask customer to confirm data residency (EU/US) for audit logs — that changes deployment region and possibly SLA.
Aisha: noted, will confirm.
